title: Read a confusion matrix
summary: A confusion matrix counts correct and incorrect class choices. With labels [0, 1], rows are true labels and columns are predicted labels.
introduction: A confusion matrix counts correct and incorrect class choices. With labels [0, 1], rows are true labels and columns are predicted labels. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A confusion matrix counts correct and incorrect class choices. With labels [0, 1], rows are true labels and columns are predicted labels.

blocks.code:
from sklearn.metrics import confusion_matrix
print(confusion_matrix([0, 0, 1, 1], [0, 1, 1, 1], labels=[0, 1]).tolist())
blocks.title: Read a confusion matrix

blocks.text: The result is [[1, 1], [0, 2]]. One true 0 was predicted as 1; both true 1 values were correct.

blocks.text: Check row and column meanings before interpreting a matrix.
